title: Add Type Adjacency Edges via Compatible Ports in Kit Diagram
description: In the kit diagram, draw adjacency edges between types that share compatible ports. Build a portGuid→typeGuids map from connectors, then use port compatibility groups to find type pairs that can connect through their ports. Draw these as reference-style edges.
summary: Extended kit diagram connection expansion so each port connection now links to the full ancestor chain of each connected type, making abstract parent types appear with reference and compatibility edges alongside concrete child types.
